metadata.pca: Centered raw pixels / 255; full SVD, no whitening; first 10 PCs for HD, PC2 and PC3 for display
metadata.replay: Scripted task replay, not participant recordings or experimental results. Target labels guide scripted cursor choices; labels never determine brush membership. Competitor radius sweeps end at their best F1 on this fixed center and sampled radius grid; this is not a global optimum or equivalent-effort benchmark.
metadata.implementation: DAB uses the slide-33 adapter plus original hull relocation. M-BALL and Data-driven use original web utils at 81e81720973b1f99d8a40a3c465447b681f843f2. M-BALL intersects its 2D circle with its HD ball; Data-driven uses its HD bounding box.
metadata.interaction: Single hover at700ms, wait1900ms, pointerdown2600ms, one uninterrupted drag at <=40 panel px/s, final pointerup52900ms. No intermediate release or click.
